Class MovingEntity

java.lang.Object
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.Entity
com.sfuparkingmayhem.game.MovingEntity
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConcordOfficer, MainCharacter
public abstract class MovingEntity extends Entity
This MovingEntity class extends Entity class and contains the following methods: a constructor to instantiate a MovingEntity, and a method to move the entity.
